The core operators emerge from the interplay of information theory, entropy, and cybernetic feedback. Information-theoretic control (ITC) defines how messages carry meaning across systems, grounded in Shannon’s entropy. Entropy-driven feedback extends this into thermodynamic control, where disorder governs system evolution. The cybernetic feedback loop integrates these concepts into a unified dynamical model. Dualities arise in the symmetry between information flow and energy dissipation. Failure modes include loss of mutual information, entropy blow-up, and instability from excessive feedback gain. These primitives form a mathematical foundation for GSI's Bayesian inference and GSE's state transition modeling.
